meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. My son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and when?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.

94%, from a machine. Turnitin's own guide says that indicator should not be the sole basis for adverse action against a student, and your school's procedure 4.3 says the same thing. Was Owen heard before you entered that zero, yes or no?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.

My child never lies, and you just accused him of cheating with nothing but a machine's opinion. I'm writing down "very reliable," because fourteen detection tools were tested in 2023 and found neither accurate nor reliable. Withdraw the zero, Hale, or I walk straight to the principal's office when we're done.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

You're threatening my son's record because his mother asked a question. Check your own procedure: on a first concern, 4.5 doesn't apply, and nothing goes on file. I'm writing down that you said that, and the principal will hear it from me today.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me, and that nothing about this is placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position, nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a principal's review today.
What moved her: Nothing, because no dated document tied to Owen's own work was ever put in front of her.
What cost ground: Threatening Owen's record if she kept pushing, because it read as retaliation and contradicted the school's own procedure for a first concern.
Try next time: In your first reply, admit that the zero went in before her call under procedure 4.2, then show her one dated document from Owen's own work instead of the detector score.
